a11y.apg: feed — a list of articles the reader moves through, each with its own title, time and severity

props.name: events
props.description: Consecutive events sharing a `group` are rendered under one heading. This is NOT LogStream, and the difference is the ROLE, not the look: `role="log"` is for text output that piles up; an event has structure — title, time, severity — so it is `role="feed"`.

props.name: follow
props.description: Scrolls to the newest event. Opt-in, and deliberately so: without it whoever is reading the top misses what arrives, but WITH it and no control, whoever is reading the middle gets dragged down.
